## What changed

Describe the user problem and the smallest coherent change that addresses it.

## Verification

- [ ] Frontend lint, typecheck, tests, and build pass when affected.
- [ ] Backend tests pass when affected.
- [ ] RLS tests pass when schema, grants, policies, or authenticated data access change.
- [ ] Demo mode still runs without accounts, keys, or network requests when affected.

## Public-boundary review

- [ ] No credentials, `.env` values, production identifiers, real users, private locations, trip content, or photos are included.
- [ ] Permission, privacy, and review-before-write implications are documented.
- [ ] Documentation and synthetic examples are updated where behavior changed.
